top_signals.title: UAE Oil Production Surged to Records in September, IEA Says
top_signals.summary: Oil output from the United Arab Emirates climbed to record levels last month, the International Energy Agency said, underscoring its resilience during the Iran war and liberation from OPEC+ limits.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Phosphate Giant Seeks Foreign Investors as War Hits Finances
top_signals.summary: Morocco’s phosphate giant OCP SA is looking to attract foreign investors for some of its businesses, as supply disruptions caused by the Iran war hit profits at the state-owned company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
